description: Compare the ReplicaSets of one Kubernetes Deployment over the last 30 minutes: requests, failed requests, error percentage, p95 latency, pod count and first-seen time per ReplicaSet and service.version, from OpenTelemetry server spans. Use this first when a rollout is suspected: a new ReplicaSet with a higher error rate than the old one points at the release.

configuration.query:
FROM traces-generic.otel-default
| WHERE @timestamp > NOW() - 30 minutes
    AND k8s.namespace.name == ?namespace AND k8s.deployment.name == ?deployment
    AND kind == "Server" AND span.name != "GET /healthz"
| STATS requests = COUNT(*),
        errors = COUNT(*) WHERE event.outcome == "failure",
        p95_ms = PERCENTILE(duration, 95),
        pods = COUNT_DISTINCT(k8s.pod.name),
        first_seen = MIN(@timestamp)
    BY k8s.replicaset.name, service.version
| EVAL error_pct = ROUND(100.0 * errors / requests, 1), p95_ms = ROUND(p95_ms / 1000000.0, 1)
| SORT first_seen
